category_title: Autistic students who correctly process problems with matching gestures
scenario_title: Identifying geometric shapes using concrete objects and gestures
minimal_context: The student is working on a worksheet to identify and classify geometric shapes by matching them with images of concrete objects.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please look at the first shape on the worksheet and find the matching object.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: a cube. (Visually perceives the cardboard and selects the picture of the dice that resembles the shape)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Move on to the next shape on the page.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Focuses on the picture of the rectangular box) Beams. (Uses a matching gesture to indicate the similarity of the shape) a pencil.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Now identify the tube from the images of the piggy bank or the football.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Points hand gestures to the image of marbles and cans of milk, visually seeing the similarity of a circular shape instead of the requested objects)
